notes: Native firmware 0.1.18 — the crash-era fixes: (1) the watchdog panic mode OFF (the TFT delivery's resume re-armed it with panic on — the panic aborts from the interrupt context and the coredump write fails silently there; the hardware-reset path of every stable era restored); (2) the mdns recv task priority 5 -> 1 (the unpinned prio-5 task processing the LAN's multicast chatter starved both idle feeds — the crash signature); (3) the OTA/TFT task priority 1 -> 3 (the delivery outranks the network chatter); (4) the watchdog suspend/resume double-call guard. Carries all prior proven fixes.

bug_fixes: 0.1.7/0.1.8: the boot reset reason is visible on the panel's web UI after every boot; TFT updates are refused while the display is not responding.
